name: prts-reader-online
description: Astro static Arknights story reader for GitHub Pages

scripts.format: prettier --write reader config/*.example.json config/data-source.json config/figure-source.json schemas *.md docs/architecture.md docs/development.md docs/reader-guide.md .github
scripts.format:check: prettier --check reader config/*.example.json config/data-source.json config/figure-source.json schemas *.md docs/architecture.md docs/development.md docs/reader-guide.md .github
